name: Admin Document Gallery View
description: Toggle between list and gallery views on /panel/documents via the 'Lista'/'Galería' segmented control (data-testid doc-view-list / doc-view-grid). Gallery renders one card per document with a sanitized markdown mini-preview (content_excerpt), status badge overlay, client + date, up to 2 tag chips with a +N tooltip, and the same kebab 'Acciones' opening DocumentActionsSheet. Subfolder cards render first with dashed borders and act as drag-and-drop targets. The chosen mode persists in localStorage (projectapp-documents-view-mode); default is 'list'. On mobile the gallery grid is always the view. Same as the list view, the DocumentActionsSheet 'Acciones' modal offers both 'Descargar PDF · Amigable' and 'Descargar PDF · Profesional' rows, matching each document's persisted template style.
